title: FarmTact V12 — Guided Farm Planning
summary: A guided Singapore Demo Farm loop connects reviewed records, evidence-bearing Council advice, calculated proposals, explicit sandbox approval, reported work and recovery planning.

changes.title: Observe, discuss and decide
changes.description: Seven functional Council roles expose evidence and withheld findings beside a visual farm board. Reviewed proposals keep confirmed orders, tentative demand and price signals separate.

changes.title: Review the Farm Data Inbox
changes.description: Synthetic examples, CSV/XLSX accounting records, manual corrections and bounded document/photo candidates retain source provenance and require confirmation. Crop photos never independently establish yield.

changes.title: Approve, act, verify and replan
changes.description: Explicit approval creates revision-bound sandbox tasks. Quantities, rejected deliveries and corrections produce auditable forecast feedback while preserving reported work. Dated Waste Rescue comparisons remain hypothetical.

changes.title: Keep two editions with recoverable retirement
changes.description: V11 and V12 retain independent images and state. Older routes return Gone. Future successful releases advance the active pair and run snapshot-backed cleanup while preserving release history.

changes.title: Learn the complete workflow
changes.description: Three captioned downloadable guides provide exact transcripts and static reading alternatives. Mission milestones identify projected, simulated and user-reported evidence; real operations remain disabled.
